business_profile.competitive_position: Best Interior Design competes in a crowded Dhaka interior market against established firms like BD INTERIOR and Rongin that have websites and phone intake. Their Instagram-first approach gives them visual reach but no owned conversion path. An AI agent that answers every DM instantly and books consultations would turn their social reach into a reliable pipeline.
business_profile.opportunity_size: At BDT 500K+ per project, even 1-2 extra closed projects per month from recovered Instagram DMs = BDT 6-12M+ in additional annual revenue. An AI DM-response + booking agent is the highest-leverage fix for an Instagram-dependent studio.
business_profile.how_the_agent_helps:
1. AI Instagram DM agent that replies to every enquiry instantly, qualifies project type and budget, and books a design consultation.
2. Portfolio-to-lead agent that engages followers who like/comment on project posts.
3. Follow-up agent that nurtures prospects who enquire but don't book immediately.
business_profile.demo_scenario: A follower sees Best Interior Design's latest living-room reveal on Instagram and DMs at midnight: 'How much for a 1500 SFT flat?' In seconds the AI replies with a ballpark range, asks 2 qualifying questions, and offers 3 consultation slots. The follower books one — a BDT 500K+ project captured while the studio slept.
